integrity: Complete self-contained proof, provenance references and independently implemented symbolic and numerical diagnostic script included; no empirical sample observations claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a homogeneous positive-rate three-state cyclic diffusivity environment with equal-duration, disjoint squared-displacement windows.
At the exceptional window widths only the specified three-window contrast is proved to vanish; global observational reversibility is not claimed.
Finite-sample statistics and wider hidden Markov models are not classified.

Absolute circulation orientation requires known diffusivity-state ordering. Publication-priority uniqueness is not independently established; the general propagator and sampled-chain reversibility results are substantial antecedents.
title: Exact sixth-order temporal chirality and blind sampling widths in cyclic switching diffusion
